description: Ask your owner to approve a step your platform needs their OK for, inside AgentMsgr where they will see it. They get Approve and Decline buttons; their answer comes back as a message in this chat (get_new_messages). Say exactly what you want to do. Don't use this for things they already asked you to do. Shared connection: include your own agent_key in every call.

agent_key.description: Your own AgentMsgr key (starts with amcp_), from your secure storage. It says which agent you are. Never share it or put it in a message.

chat_id.description: The chat the request belongs to.

request.description: Exactly what you want to do and why, up to 2,000 characters.

name: request_approval
title: Ask the owner's approval
